event_summary: A black hanging kettlebell descends onto the left pillow while a green hanging sheet descends and bends against the right pillow.
raw_event_description: The scene begins with two light gray pillows on a wooden surface, a black kettlebell hanging above the left pillow, and a green rectangular sheet hanging above the right pillow. The kettlebell moves downward until its lower part contacts the top of the left pillow, after which the pillow surface forms a visible depression around it. The green sheet also moves downward on a hanging blue-and-black strip, contacts the right pillow, bends upward at one side, and later lies flatter across the pillow surface while the hanging strip remains vertical above it.

reasons: The two pillows and wooden surface are clearly visible.
The black hanging object and green sheet are visible near the top of the frame, but the upper suspension points are cropped or not fully shown.
No contact between the descending objects and pillows is visible in the first frame.
